title: Click handler without keyboard equivalent
user_impact: Keyboard users cannot trigger the function.
technical_impact: onclick on a <div>/<span> without onkeydown/onkeyup, tabindex, or a matching role.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard and SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
checks.applicability: Rendered elements that look clickable (computed cursor: pointer or an onclick attribute) and are not controls themselves.
checks.expectation:
needs_review once per element where a pointer cursor starts (not where it is
inherited) on an element with text that is no control, has no role or
tabindex, and contains no control: if it does something, the keyboard cannot
reach it. Not reported: the card pattern (cursor on a box around a link),
real controls with a pointer cursor, descendants inheriting the cursor,
elements already reported by keyboard/click-handler-not-focusable, and
elements not rendered. A cursor set only by a media query on the phone
viewport, or by script after load, counts.
